name: Deck of Illusions, 11 Cards Missing (Cressida Moor's)

description.value:
Whose it was. Lady Cressida Moor, a Galtan card sharp. Celmak borrowed the missing cards to study; she has them in the Booth.

Use the standard rules for a deck of illusions (Core Rulebook), minus eleven cards.

From the hoard of the fallen, sorted by owner and labelled in Celmak's neat handwriting.
